Hi all,

Drafting the benchmark bundle now. Summary of what I propose:

1) Benchmark package (3 days)
- Dedicated test pool (4x A100 equivalent) for 72 hours
- Pre-baked harness with Elena’s test set + load profile (attached .xlsx)
- Metrics captured: p50/p95 latency, throughput (tokens/s), cost-per-token estimate

2) Phased uptier (90 days)
- Week 0: canary (10% traffic) — 1 week
- Weeks 1–4: stage 1 (25% traffic) — monitor cost/quality
- Weeks 5–12: stage 2 (50–100% as agreed) — scaling bakeouts

3) Save/offering concessions
- 2-month promotional price at 12% off list for incremental capacity if signed within 14 days of benchmark
- Free onboarding support (2 SRE days) for the canary run

I’ve attached the benchmark workbook and a rough phased_uptier_proposal.pdf.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
